x: His father introduced him to Wally Ives, a Brighton walker, and so Hall Junior joined the Belgrave ranks completely unaware of the fate that lay before him.
Captain Tommy Green recently met with a bombing accident and suffered three slight wounds. Wally Ives, out in India, writes ``Always I am waiting for the call which means HOME and WIMBLEDON''.
Wally Ives, then in India, became a work colleague of my father and in 1948 (Olympic Year thanks Arthur) through him I was introduced to what I thought was a rambling club - some ramble!
